paragraphs.text: # dsh-memory
**Long-term experience memory for any LLM running inside DeepSeek Harness.**

Your model forgets everything when the chat window scrolls away. `dsh-memory` gives it a local,
prov

ider-agnostic memory store: it can **search past experience before starting a task**, **save
lessons

the user confirms**, **report how a lesson worked out**, and **see the whole library as an
interact

**, **report how a lesson worked out**, and **see the whole library as an
interactive 3D star map**.
No cloud, no vendor lock-in, no model-specific skill format — just five tools plus one settings page
o cloud, no vendor lock-in, no model-specific skill format — just five tools plus one settings page.
## Features
| 🔎 `memory_search` | Cross-session retrieval with relevance, confidence, maturity, premise/counter,

conflicts, provenance, staleness |
| 📄 `memory_get` | Full text and metadata for one entry |
| 📊 `m

emory_status` | Counts, archive, pending proposals, maturity distribution, data location |
| 💾 `memo
ry_save` | Store a lesson — summary, detail, tags, premise, counter, score, case type, pin, source r

eference |
| 🔁 `memory_feedback` | `good` / `bad` / `neutral` outcome, advances maturity (`draft → a

ctive → trusted`, `bad → flipped`) |
| 🌌 3D star map | Zones = nebulae, subzones = clusters, units =
stars; orbit camera, click-to-focus, pending proposals fall as clickable meteors |
Design rules baked in:
- **Human in the loop.** Writes ask for approval through the Harness approval service and fail close

d when it is unavailable.
- **Nothing is silently overwritten.** Conflicting lessons are kept and re

turned as a pair.
- **Everything is auditable.** Each entry has a version, a provenance field, and a
maturity state driven only by explicit feedback.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with plugin support (`plugin_manager`), desktop or CLI profile
- Python **3.8+**

available as `python` (Windows) / `python3` (macOS, Linux), or point `pythonExe` at an interpreter
-
No npm dependencies. The client half is plain JavaScript and plain Canvas; there is no build step.

### 2. Install into your DSH profile
Ask the agent (or the Plugins page) to install the bundle by directory:

That is the whole installation: the manager links the package, applies `cordis.patch.yml`, and the
f
ive tools appear in the model's tool list.

> **Client half needs one restart.** The 3D star map lives in the Web UI. After the first install,
>
quit and reopen DeepSeek Harness once; later edits to `client.js` only need a page refresh.
### 3. Configure (optional)

Configuration is a plain object on the plugin row. Every field has a working default, so an empty
co

is a plain object on the plugin row. Every field has a working default, so an empty
config is valid:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `dataDir` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\doubao-memory\data` (`~/.local/share` elsewhere) | Where the JSON memo

ry store lives |
| `scriptPath` | bundled `memory_onefile.py` | Point at your own copy of the engine

|
| `pythonExe` | `python` / `python3` | Interpreter to run the engine |
| `maxResults` | `6` | Def

ault result cap for `memory_search` |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-command timeout |
| `allowWrites

` | `true` | Set `false` for a read-only deployment |
| `requireApproval` | `true` | Ask the user be

fore writes |
| `allowUiWrites` | `true` | Enable the Approve/Reject buttons on the star map |
| `pr
omptHint` | `true` | Inject a short behavioural hint into the system prompt |
## Use it
Ask the model in plain language:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or drive the same engine from a terminal (no Harness needed):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The CLI has its own command reference: `python memory_onefile.py --help`.
## The 3D star map
Settings → **Memory star map**:
- **Zones** render as nebulae, **subzones** as star clusters, each **unit** as a star whose size and

brightness track confidence and heat, and whose colour encodes maturity
(blue = draft, green = acti

ve, gold = trusted, red = flipped).
- **Pinned** entries carry a white ring; **conflicts** are joine

d by red dashed lines; archived
(cold-storage) entries appear in a dim region of their own.
- **Inte

ractions:** drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, double-click to reset, toggle auto-rotation,
hover for a

summary, **click a star to fly the camera to it**, and click a falling **meteor** to
approve or reje

ct a pending proposal.
- Camera distance is derived from the scene's bounding sphere, so any data vo

lume stays framed.
- Empty stores show a friendly hint instead of an empty void.
### Read-only data route
The page renders from one same-origin endpoint, served by the Host half:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Proposal actions (the only write route)
The Approve/Reject buttons post here; it is the human click that authorises the write:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Only pending proposals are accepted; `approve` runs `approve --execute`, `reject` runs
`reject -r "界
面驳回"`. Disable the route entirely with `allowUiWrites: false`.
## Data model
One JSON file per unit under `main_library/units/`, version snapshots under `forget_layer1/snapshots

/`,
archived units under `forget_layer2/cold_units/`, proposals under `proposals/`. The layout is st

able
and human-readable; you can back it up, diff it, or migrate it with plain tools.
A unit carries: `summary`, `content`, `tags`, `premise`, `counter`, `score`, `case_type`, `pinned`,
`source_ref`, `maturity`, `version`, `conflict_ids`, `active_score`, `access_unseal_count`.
## Security notes
- Both HTTP routes bind to the Harness Web server on `127.0.0.1` only. There is no additional auth —

the trade-off of a single-user local tool. Set `allowUiWrites: false` if that matters to you.
- Wri

tes from the model go through the approval service; without it (or without a session context)
they f

ail closed rather than writing silently.
- The plugin never edits the session log, never registers c

ustom session events, and stores nothing
outside `dataDir`.
## FAQ

**The star map page is missing after install.** The client half is loaded from the app bundle at
sta
rtup — restart DeepSeek Harness once.
